items.name: slider
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Slider
items.description: A slider that is a bamboo rake in a tray of sand. Drag right and its four tines cut grooves and push a little heap of sand ahead of it; pull back and its back drags the sand flat again. One file of about 170 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-slider>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-slider value="40" label="Volume"></sand-slider>. Read el.value; it fires input while it moves and change when it comes to rest. min, max and step work; with a name it is sent with its form. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: toggle
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Toggle
items.description: A switch that is a river stone in a tray of raked sand. Switch it on and the stone glides along, parting the sand into a wake, and uncovers a power symbol it had pressed into the sand where it was resting. One file of about 170 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-toggle>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-toggle label="Focus mode"></sand-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: signature
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Signature
items.description: A signature pad of smoothed sand, written in with a stick that cuts like a brush: linger and the line is wide and deep, hurry and it thins. The sand heaps up along the line. Clear sends a rake across that smooths it all away. One file of about 170 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-signature>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Signature is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/signature.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-signature name="signature"></sand-signature>. el.empty, el.undo(), el.clear() and el.toDataURL() give you the signature as ink on a transparent PNG; it fires input after each stroke. With a name its form gets the PNG. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: thinking
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Thinking
items.description: An AI agent's working state as a rock in a round tray of sand that rakes itself. Thinking draws rings round the rock, searching draws spokes, using a tool draws lines that flow round it like water, and writing draws dashes like lines of text. One file of about 370 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-thinking>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Thinking is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/thinking.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-thinking state="thinking"></sand-thinking> and set el.state to thinking, searching, tool, writing or idle as your agent works. It is a status region, so the state is read out. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: checkbox
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox where a small river stone rolls aside to reveal a checkmark etched into a circular sand well. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-checkbox>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Checkbox is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/checkbox.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-checkbox label="Enable notifications" value="notifications"></sand-checkbox>. Read el.checked; it fires input and change when toggled. With a name, a checked value is submitted with its form. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: radio-group
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Radio Group

items.title: GrainMotion-UI Segmented Control

items.name: range
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Range Slider
items.description: A two-handle range slider with independently adjustable bamboo rake markers and a visibly disturbed selected interval. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-range>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Range Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/range.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-range name="budget" label="Budget range" min="0" max="100" step="5" low="20" high="80"></sand-range>. Read el.low and el.high; el.value returns the pair. It fires input while adjusting and change when an interaction completes. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: rating
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Rating
items.description: A five-point rating control where a selected river stone marks the chosen rating in one of five individual sand wells. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-rating>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Rating is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/rating.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-rating name="product-rating" label="Product rating" value="4"></sand-rating>. Read el.value and listen for input/change. The supported scale is zero through five. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: input
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Text Field
items.description: A native text input with a bamboo stylus-like focus marker and fine pressed guide line, retaining normal browser editing, selection and validation. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-input>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Text Field is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/input.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-input name="displayName" label="Display name" placeholder="Your name"></sand-input>. Read or set el.value; native input and change events bubble from its internal input. Supported types are text, email, tel, url and search. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: textarea
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Textarea
items.description: A native multiline textarea over a wider sand tray, with shallow writing grooves and a moving stylus focus cue. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-textarea>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Textarea is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/textarea.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-textarea name="message" label="Message" rows="4" maxlength="500"></sand-textarea>. Read or set el.value; native input and change events bubble from the internal textarea. Rows are clamped from 2 to 10. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: password
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Password Field
items.description: A native password input with a physical Show/Hide stone shutter. The value remains masked by default and is never printed in the demo status text. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-password>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Password Field is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/password.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-password name="password" label="Password" autocomplete="current-password"></sand-password>. Read or set el.value. The revealed property or attribute toggles visibility; password is hidden by default. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: search
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Search Field
items.description: A native search input with a small search well, a clear button, an Enter-to-search event and a moving sand rake while busy. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-search>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Search Field is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/search.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-search name="q" label="Search" placeholder="Search"></sand-search>. Pressing Enter dispatches a bubbling search event with detail.value. Set el.busy=true while your application fetches results; call el.clear() to reset. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: otp
items.title: GrainMotion-UI OTP / PIN Input
items.description: A numeric OTP/PIN input drawn across individual engraved wells. One native input preserves mobile one-time-code autofill, paste, selection and keyboard behavior. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-otp>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI OTP / PIN Input is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/otp.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-otp name="verificationCode" label="Verification code" length="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" required></sand-otp>. Length is clamped from four to ten. The complete event exposes detail.length only, never the entered digits. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: select
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Select / Dropdown
items.description: A native select control with a floating river stone and a carved chevron. The browser retains its familiar option popup, keyboard navigation and form semantics. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-select>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Select / Dropdown is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/select.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-select name="delivery" label="Delivery speed" options="Standard,Express,Overnight" placeholder="Choose delivery"></sand-select>. Options are comma-separated; use value:Label for distinct submitted values and visible labels. Read or set el.value. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: combobox
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Combobox / Autocomplete
items.description: A native text input connected to a datalist for browser-managed suggestions. It permits free text, keyboard entry and paste while a small rake follows the query. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-combobox>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Combobox / Autocomplete is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/combobox.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-combobox name="city" label="City" options="DEL:Delhi,BLR:Bengaluru,HYD:Hyderabad" placeholder="Start typing"></sand-combobox>. The browser provides the datalist suggestion UI. Read or set el.value; free text is allowed. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: date-picker
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Date Picker
items.description: A native date input over an engraved sand calendar. The value remains an ISO YYYY-MM-DD date string, with min, max and unavailable-day validation that avoids local timezone conversions. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-date-picker>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Date Picker is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/date-picker.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-date-picker name="startDate" label="Start date" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31" unavailable="2026-12-25"></sand-date-picker>. The value uses YYYY-MM-DD and is not converted through the local timezone. The native date picker handles calendar keyboard interaction. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: date-range
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Date Range Picker
items.description: Two native date fields represent an inclusive calendar range. The component validates order, required endpoints, min/max bounds and unavailable days; it serializes complete ranges as start/end ISO strings. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-date-range>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Date Range Picker is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/date-range.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-date-range name="stay" start="2026-11-21" end="2026-11-25" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31"></sand-date-range>. The value is `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD`; start and end are separate properties. Dates are compared as calendar days, not local timestamps. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: time-picker
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Time Picker
items.description: A native time input paired with a circular sand dial and deterministic 12/24-hour readout. Values remain timezone-free HH:MM strings; min, max and step use native time constraints. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-time-picker>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Time Picker is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/time-picker.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-time-picker name="appointment" label="Appointment time" format="12" min="09:00" max="17:30" step="900"></sand-time-picker>. Read or set el.value in 24-hour `HH:MM` form. The `format` property controls a 12/24-hour readout; native input presentation follows browser locale. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI
